provider: HKU Politics and Public Administration and Faculty of Law
note: The official Programme-specific table applies to students admitted in 2024-25 and thereafter and defines a 300-credit double degree: 96 credits in Politics and Public Administration, 156 credits in the Law Professional Core, 24 Common Core credits, 18 English/free-elective credits and 6 Chinese-language credits. It explicitly identifies the fixed PPA, language and Law codes, two PPA capstone alternatives, ten Law capstone alternatives and seven designated Law disciplinary electives. The current 2025-26 LLB syllabus no longer lists LLAW3058 as a designated capstone and names LLAW3230 Public interest clinic rather than Business of justice clinic, so this supplement publishes the nine-code current intersection and uses the current title. The current BSocSc syllabus closes the six coded Social Innovation and Global Citizenship experiential alternatives. The Programme-specific table does not publish a closed pool for the eight required PPA electives or the broader 42-credit Law elective requirement, and its unnamed FOSS introductory course, Common Core courses and free electives cannot be mapped without inference. This is therefore a partial read-only planning list and must not produce a completion percentage.

supplements.evidenceNote: Only Programme-specific fixed codes, current coded experiential alternatives and the current Law capstone intersection are published. The eight-course PPA elective pool and broader 42-credit Law elective universe remain intentionally excluded.
